packageRules.description: Docusaurus is incompatible with TypeScript 7: @docusaurus/tsconfig still uses baseUrl, which TS 7 removed. Lift this cap once Docusaurus supports TS 7.
The uuid override exists only to patch GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq under sockjs (webpack-dev-server). Stay on 11.x, which sockjs works with; drop the override and this rule when upstream updates.
